title: Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXI OF 2010
ACT XXI OF 2010
PAKISTAN ATOMIC ENERGY COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Atomic
Energy Commission Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
4th December, 2010]
The
following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the President on 1st December, 2010 and is hereby
published for general information:
Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission
Ordinance, 1965 (XVII of 1965), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as under:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission (Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 3B, Ordinance XVII of 1965

(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Atomic
Energy Commission Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
4th December, 2010]
The
following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the President on 1st December, 2010 and is hereby
published for general information:
Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission
Ordinance, 1965 (XVII of 1965), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as under:--
2. Amendment
of section 3B, Ordinance XVII of 1965.---In the
Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission Ordinance, 1965 (XVII of 1965), hereinafter
referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 3B,---
(a)
in the marginal note for the words and figures Ordinance XXIII of 1969 not to
apply Commission the words, letters and figures Act IV of 2008 not to apply
to Commission shall be substituted; and
(b) for the word, comma and figure Ordinance, 1969 the words,
comma, letters, brackets and figures Act 2008 (Act IV of 2008) shall be
substituted.

4th December, 2010]
The
following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the President on 1st December, 2010 and is hereby
published for general information:
Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission
Ordinance, 1965 (XVII of 1965), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as under:--
3. Amendment
of section 4, Ordinance XVII of 1965.---In the
said Ordinance, in section 4,---
(a) in subsection (1),---
(i) in clause (c), for the word
five the word seven shall be substituted; and
(ii)
after clause (c), amended as aforesaid, the heading
Part-time members and clauses (d) and (e) shall be omitted; and
(b) after subsection (4) the following new subsection shall be
added, namely:---
(5)
Notwithstanding the composition of the Board prescribed in subsection (1), the
Federal Government may increase or decrease the number of
members of the
Commission and prescribe
the qualifications and mode of appointment in such manner as it may deem
appropriate.
